rv.q: The cast’s voices aren’t always top-notch, and the musical arrangements sometimes seem a bit muddled. That improvised air nonetheless evokes a boisterous spirit of teenage rebellion as Conor clashes with his school headmaster Brother Baxter (Martin Moran), who is at once witty, erudite and abusive.
3/5 Stars. "Despite some weaknesses, 'Sing Street' makes an adequately entertaining evening; but the magic of something like Once rarely comes twice."
